data.title: Club Place
data.about:
After the success of Club Drive, Emaar Properties has launched another luxury project at Dubai Hills Estate, Club Place. Emaar Club Place features 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments nestled in the opulent community. Club Place is situated adjacent to the Golf Club Villas community.

Overlooking the Dubai Hills Golf Course and neighboring low-rise communities, the apartments boast scenic views. Residents of the Club Place Project by Emaar Properties offer excellent amenities like a gym, swimming pool, and sports courts.

characteristics_module.title: A Premier Property within the Prestigious Dubai Hills Estate community
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• The Club Place Project by Emaar Properties features 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments.
  • The complex is within walking distance of Dubai Hills Park, providing a serene environment amidst lush greenery.
  • The facilities at Club Place at Dubai Hills Estate include pools, sports courts, and sky terraces and more.
  • Near an 18-hole Championship Golf Course, the apartments are perfect for golf enthusiasts.
  • Club Place Dubai Hills Estate by Emaar is designed for contemporary living, ideal for those seeking a harmonious blend of luxury and convenience.

location_tile.title: A Serene Community With a Rapidly Growing Property Market
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Dubai Hills Park, located at the heart of Dubai Hills Estate, is a vibrant green oasis spanning over 180,000 square meters. This expansive park offers a serene escape from the bustling city, featuring lush landscapes, scenic walking trails, and beautifully manicured gardens. 

Residents and visitors alike can enjoy a variety of outdoor activities, from leisurely strolls and picnics to jogging and cycling. The park also includes children's play areas, splash pads, and sports facilities, making it an ideal destination for families and fitness enthusiasts.

Dubai Hills Park within walking distance
4 Minutes to Dubai Hills Mall
6 Minutes to Dubai Hills Golf Club
15 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
25 Minutes to Dubai International Airport

seo.metaTitle: Club Place by Emaar at Dubai Hills Estate
seo.metaDescription: Emaar Club Place is an upcoming project at Dubai Hills Estate. It features luxury 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments offering scenic views.

more_info.answer: Club Place offers luxurious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, designed with modern sophistication and the lavish style of Palace Hotels and Resorts.
more_info.question: What types of apartments are available at Club Place by Emaar?

more_info.answer: Residents at Club Place can enjoy a range of exceptional amenities, including multiple pools, sports facilities, sky terraces, a gym, and direct access to Dubai Hills Park and Dubai Hills Mall.
more_info.question: What amenities can residents enjoy at Emaar Club Place?

more_info.answer: Club Place is situated within Dubai Hills Estate, in Dubai Hills Park. This prime location offers a serene environment with lush greenery and excellent connectivity between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina, as well as easy access to Al Khail Road.
